'''''Cerar Be Kyr'am'''''&mdash;"'''Mountain of Death'''" in [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']]&mdash;was the name given to a large [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] that [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla's]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] kept on [[Tracyn Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. The creature was one of a number of challenges that were kept in the Mandalorians' compound to test themselves against.

==Behind the scenes==
''Cerar Be Kyr'am'' first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The rancor is one of three bosses&mdash;along with the [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] ''[[Adeen Edeemir]]'' and the [[Lurker/Legends|lurker]] ''[[Pirun Ut]]''&mdash;that appear in one iteration of the "Blood Hunt" Tactical Flashpoint; a second version of the Flashpoint features the [[tonitran]] ''[[Hodayc Sur'haai]]'', the [[jurgoran]] ''[[Yustapir Kyramud]]'' and the [[krak'jya]] ''[[Dralne be te Oya'karir]]''. As the challenges can change, this article refrains from specifying which challenges were faced by the [[canon]] characters.<ref name="Blood Hunt" />
